body.div:
graph LR subgraph "Phase 1: Candidate Setup" A1["User Profile
Name, Email"] A2["Skills & Experience
Validated, Stored"] A3["GitHub Projects
Imported, Cached"] A4["Approved Resumes
≥3 versions"] A1 --> A2 --> A3 --> A4 end
subgraph "Phase 2: Job Discovery" B1["Job Posting
Raw Input"] B2["Deterministic:
Dedup, Normalize"] B3["LLM: JobAnalysis
Extract Requirements
REQUIRED/PREFERRED"] B4["Job Stored
with Classification"] B1 --> B2 --> B3 --> B4 end
subgraph "Phase 3: Job-Candidate Matching" C1["Load Job
& Candidate"] C2["LLM: Semantic Analysis
Skills vs Requirements"] C3["Deterministic:
Classify Each Req
SUPPORTED/PARTIAL/NOT/UNKNOWN"] C4["Deterministic:
Calculate Score
Weighted by Tier"] C5["Route to Category
STRONG/NEAR/POOR"] C1 --> C2 --> C3 --> C4 --> C5 end
subgraph "Phase 4: Intelligence" D1["LLM: CompanyAnalysis
from Job Listing"] D2["LLM: ProjectIntel
GitHub Repos"] D3["Store Sourced Info
VERIFIED/INFERRED"] D1 --> D3 D2 --> D3 end
subgraph "Phase 5: Resume Strategy" E1["For STRONG_MATCH
or NEAR_MATCH"] E2["Best Resume Identified
Deterministic"] E3["LLM: Propose Direction
Tailored to Job"] E4["LLM: Generate Proposal
Evidence-backed"] E5["Proposal: PROPOSED
Awaiting Approval"] E1 --> E2 --> E3 --> E4 --> E5 end
subgraph "Phase 6: Validation" F1["User Reviews
Proposal"] F2["LLM: Critic Agent
Checks Completeness
Verifies Evidence"] F3["Critic: PASS or FAIL
with Findings"] F4["Max 3 Revisions
Prevent Loops"] F1 --> F2 --> F3 --> F4 end
subgraph "Phase 7: Application Prep" G1["User Approval
Resume + Job"] G2["Deterministic:
Package Materials
Resume + Job Snapshot"] G3["Immutable
Application Record
Match Score Captured"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 end
subgraph "Phase 8: Submission" H1["Application Mode
PREPARE / APPROVAL
/ AUTO_APPLY"] H2["PREPARE: User submits
APPROVAL: Show + confirm
AUTO_APPLY: Execute"] H3["Timestamp recorded
Status: APPLIED"] H1 --> H2 --> H3 end
subgraph "Phase 9: Tracking" I1["Track Status
DISCOVERED→APPLIED
→INTERVIEW→etc."] I2["Optional: Calendar
Follow-up Reminders"] I3["Optional: Gmail
Recruiter Responses"] I4["Full Audit Trail
Decisions & Changes"] I1 --> I2 --> I3 --> I4 end
A4 --> B1 B4 --> C1 C5 --> D1 D3 --> E1 E5 --> F1 F4 --> G1 G3 --> H1 H3 --> I1
classDef setupStyle fill:#c8e6c9 classDef discoveryStyle fill:#bbdefb classDef matchStyle fill:#fff9c4 classDef intelStyle fill:#f8bbd0 classDef strategyStyle fill:#ffe0b2 classDef validationStyle fill:#ffccbc classDef prepStyle fill:#d1c4e9 classDef submitStyle fill:#b2ebf2 classDef trackStyle fill:#c5cae9
class A1,A2,A3,A4 setupStyle class B1,B2,B3,B4 discoveryStyle class C1,C2,C3,C4,C5 matchStyle class D1,D2,D3 intelStyle class E1,E2,E3,E4,E5 strategyStyle class F1,F2,F3,F4 validationStyle class G1,G2,G3 prepStyle class H1,H2,H3 submitStyle class I1,I2,I3,I4 trackStyle
